sentences.text: Maximum Overdrive is a 1986 American science fiction action horror comedy film written and directed by Stephen King .	Stephen King	Stephen King	science fiction	science fiction	action	action film	horror comedy	horror comedy	film	film

The film stars Emilio Estevez , Pat Hingle , Laura Harrington , and Yeardley Smith .	Emilio Estevez	Emilio Estevez	Pat Hingle	Pat Hingle	Laura Harrington	Laura Harrington	film	film	Yeardley Smith	Yeardley Smith

The screenplay was inspired by and loosely based on King 's short story `` Trucks '' , which was included in King 's first collection of short stories , Night Shift .	Trucks	Trucks (short story)	short story	short story	Night Shift	Night Shift (book)

Maximum Overdrive is King 's only directorial effort , though dozens of films have been based on one of his novels or short stories .	films	List of Stephen King films	his novels or short stories	Stephen King bibliography
The film contained black humor elements and a generally campy tone , which contrasts with King 's sombre subject matter in books .	film	film	black humor	black humor	campy	Camp (style)
The film has a mid-1980s hard rock soundtrack composed entirely by the group AC/DC , King 's favorite band .	AC/DC	AC/DC	film	film	hard rock	hard rock
AC/DC 's album Who Made Who was released as the Maximum Overdrive soundtrack .	AC/DC	AC/DC	Who Made Who	Who Made Who (song)

It includes the best-selling singles `` Who Made Who '' , `` You Shook Me All Night Long '' , and `` Hells Bells '' .	Who Made Who	Who Made Who (song)	singles	single (music)	You Shook Me All Night Long	You Shook Me All Night Long	Hells Bells	Hells Bells (song)

The film was nominated for two Golden Raspberry Awards including Worst Director for King and Worst Actor for Estevez in 1987 , but both lost against Prince for Under the Cherry Moon .	film	film	Golden Raspberry Awards	Golden Raspberry Awards	Worst Director	Golden Raspberry Award for Worst Director	Worst Actor	Golden Raspberry Award for Worst Actor	Prince	Prince (musician)	Under the Cherry Moon	Under the Cherry Moon
In 1988 , Maximum Overdrive was nominated for `` Best Film '' at the International Fantasy Film Awards .
King himself described the film as a `` moron movie '' and stated his intention to never direct again soon after .	film	film
